SUNOG NA SUMIKLAB SA NIA ROAD, QC, NASA IKALIMANG ALARMA 

Isang sunog ang sumiklab sa isang residential area sa NIA Road, Brgy. Pinyahan, Quezon City ngayong Biyernes ng gabi, March 6, 2026.

As of 9:44 PM, umabot na sa ikalimang alarma ang sunog, ayon sa Bureau of Fire Protection.

TASK FORCE ALPHA RAISED IN QC FIRE

LOOK: Volunteer firefighters from outside Quezon City were among those who responded to the blaze at Bgy. Pinyahan, which has now been raised to Task Force Alpha and is still raging close to three hours later. (📸: Central Tonsuya Fire Brigade) | via @anjo_bagaoisan https://t.co/mfTwLiSjqD
